title: cog-rank-next-up input
description: The items, the dependency findings, the classifications and the ranking policy. Declared from the manifest as context.input_schema. This Cog reaches nothing: it is invoked with no grant.

items.description: The github-items artifact's items. Closed-context items are read and ignored: they are duplicate-detection context and are never ranked.

dependency_findings.description: openteams/cog-dependency-detector's payload, or null when that step was skipped. Only `stated` findings move an item; `inferred` ones are advisory.

classifications.description: The classify-items foreach step's payload: one openteams/cog-issue-classifier payload per item, null where that element failed its Gate. An item with no classification is unrated.

ranking_policy.description: The ranking-policy artifact. `priority_order` overrides the default P0, P1, P2, P3, unrated, so the team can change the policy without touching this Cog.
